archived.name: Personal Dashboard Web Application
archived.description: Build a beautiful, modern Personal Dashboard with weather widget, quick notes, task manager, pomodoro timer, and quick links. Full-stack with React/TypeScript frontend and Node.js/Express/SQLite backend.
verification: Frontend builds without errors
Backend starts and responds to health check
Weather widget displays current conditions
Notes can be created, edited, and deleted
Tasks can be added, completed, and removed
Pomodoro timer counts down correctly
Quick links are customizable
Responsive design works on mobile
Data persists in SQLite database

archived.name: Design Revamp with Micro-Interactions
archived.description: Revamp the Personal Dashboard design with a fresh, modern aesthetic using the frontend-design plugin. Add polished micro-interactions using motion.dev (motion/react) - including hover effects, tap feedback, smooth transitions, layout animations, spring physics, and scroll-triggered animations.
verification: All 5 widgets have updated, cohesive design
Motion library installed and configured
Hover effects on all interactive elements
Tap/click feedback on buttons and cards
Smooth transitions when switching widget states
Layout animations for list items (tasks, notes, links)
Enter/exit animations for modals and new items
Responsive design maintained on all screen sizes
No performance degradation (animations run at 60fps+)
Build completes without errors

technicalNotes.designApproach: Use frontend-design plugin for distinctive, production-grade interface

archived.name: Modal Styling & UX Improvements
archived.description: Ensure popup modals are correctly styled and inline with the Crystalline Noir design system. Improve UX with proper focus management, form validation feedback, and consistent styling across all widget modals (Notes, Tasks, Pomodoro Settings, Quick Links).
verification: All modal form inputs use consistent noir/amber styling
Form labels and placeholders are readable with proper contrast
Buttons inside modals match the app's Button component styling
Focus states are visible and accessible
Form validation provides clear feedback
Modal content is properly scrollable for long forms
Close button (X) and Escape key work correctly
Tab order is logical within modals
Mobile responsive layout works correctly
Playwright tests validate modal functionality

technicalNotes.testingApproach: Use Playwright MCP for automated UI testing
technicalNotes.designSystem: Crystalline Noir with dark amber (#b45309) accents

archived.name: Manual City Entry for Weather Widget
archived.description: Add manual city entry functionality to the Weather Widget, allowing users to type in a city name and get weather data for that location. Uses Open-Meteo geocoding API.
verification: Text input for city name is visible and styled consistently
Users can type a city name and search for weather
Geocoding API returns valid coordinates for the city
Weather data displays correctly for the selected city
Selected city persists across page refreshes
Invalid city names show appropriate error message
Build completes without errors
TypeScript type checking passes

archived.name: Claude API Backend
archived.description: Secure integration with Anthropic API for AI-powered productivity features. Foundation for Smart Productivity Assistant suite.
verification: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY loaded from environment variable
API key never exposed to frontend (server-side only)
POST /api/ai/complete endpoint accepts prompts and returns responses
Rate limiting prevents abuse (10 requests/minute per client)
Error handling for API failures (timeouts, rate limits, invalid keys)
Usage logged to SQLite (tracking tokens, timestamps)
Server builds without TypeScript errors

keyImplementation: Rate limiting middleware (10 req/min per IP)

archived.name: Natural Language Task Entry
archived.description: Parse natural language into structured tasks using Claude AI. Example: 'Buy groceries tomorrow morning' becomes a task with title, due date, and priority.
verification: Natural language input field visible in Tasks widget
Parses dates correctly (today, tomorrow, next week, specific dates)
Extracts priority from urgency words (urgent, important, low priority)
Shows loading animation during AI processing
Graceful fallback if AI unavailable
Matches Crystalline Noir design system
Client builds without TypeScript errors

archived.name: Smart Task Suggestions
archived.description: AI-powered task recommendations based on existing tasks and patterns. Analyzes completed and pending tasks to suggest related tasks or next steps.
verification: Get Suggestions button visible in Tasks widget
AI analyzes last 20 tasks for context
Returns 3 actionable suggestions
One-click to add suggestion as task
Dismiss animation for rejected suggestions
Works gracefully with few tasks (helpful messaging)
Client builds without TypeScript errors

keyImplementation: Purple gradient styling for AI features

archivedFixes.name: Cannot mark task as completed - missing PATCH /toggle endpoint
archivedFixes.description: Users cannot mark tasks as completed by clicking the checkbox. The client calls PATCH /api/tasks/:id/toggle but this endpoint is missing from the server routes.

archivedFixes.name: InsightsWidget should update reactively when tasks change
archivedFixes.description: The InsightsWidget displays task completion stats but doesn't update when tasks are added, completed, or deleted in the TasksWidget. Implemented custom events for cross-component communication.
